title: Selecting Historic Airphotos for Floodplain Change Detection
text: floodplain AOI comes flooded::fl_valley_confine() — valley confinement algorithm uses DEM, slope raster, stream network, precipitation model water can spread laterally. script data-raw/floodplain_co.R runs pipeline: script data-raw/floodplain_co.R outputs four AOI variants exploring different levels cleanup diggs: Raw VCA + waterbodies — everything algorithm produces Anchor 4+ — patch cleanup using order 4+ streams Anchor 2+ — patch cleanup using order 2+ streams (retains wetland complexes connected via small tributaries) Accessible — anchor 2+ minus watersheds upstream Bulkley Falls Buck Falls
code: library(flooded) library(fresh)  # Query order 4+ streams for VCA input streams_vca <- frs_network_prune(   blue_line_key = 360873822,   downstream_route_measure = 166030.4,   stream_order_min = 4, watershed_group_code = "BULK",   table = "bcfishpass.streams_co_vw",   cols = c("segmented_stream_id", "blue_line_key", "waterbody_key",            "downstream_route_measure", "upstream_area_ha",            "map_upstream", "gnis_name", "stream_order", "channel_width",            "mapping_code", "rearing", "spawning", "access", "geom"),   wscode_col = "wscode", localcode_col = "localcode" ) |> sf::st_zm(drop = TRUE)  # Query order 2+ streams for connectivity anchor streams_anchor <- frs_network_prune(   blue_line_key = 360873822,   downstream_route_measure = 166030.4,   stream_order_min = 2, watershed_group_code = "BULK",   table = "bcfishpass.streams_co_vw",   cols = c("segmented_stream_id", "blue_line_key", "upstream_area_ha",            "stream_order", "geom"),   wscode_col = "wscode", localcode_col = "localcode" ) |> sf::st_zm(drop = TRUE)  # Query waterbodies (lakes + wetlands) for VCA gap-filling wb <- frs_network(   blue_line_key = 360873822, downstream_route_measure = 166030.4,   tables = list(     lakes = "whse_basemapping.fwa_lakes_poly",     wetlands = "whse_basemapping.fwa_wetlands_poly"   ) ) waterbodies <- rbind(   wb$lakes[, "geom"] |> sf::st_zm(drop = TRUE),   wb$wetlands[, "geom"] |> sf::st_zm(drop = TRUE) )  # Run VCA with waterbodies (fills lake/wetland donut holes) valleys <- fl_valley_confine(   dem, streams_vca,   field = "upstream_area_ha",   slope = slope, slope_threshold = 9, max_width = 2000,   cost_threshold = 2500, flood_factor = 6,   precip = fl_stream_rasterize(streams_vca, dem, field = "map_upstream"),   size_threshold = 5000, hole_threshold = 2500,   waterbodies = waterbodies )  # Dual stream order cleanup: order 2+ anchor sees tributaries connecting patches anchor_r <- fl_stream_rasterize(streams_anchor, dem, field = "upstream_area_ha") valleys <- fl_patch_conn(valleys, anchor_r) valleys <- fl_patch_rm(valleys, min_area = 5000)  # Polygonize and save as GeoJSON for diggs valleys_poly <- fl_valley_poly(valleys) sf::st_write(sf::st_transform(valleys_poly, 4326),   "data/floodplain_co.geojson" )

title: Selecting Historic Airphotos for Floodplain Change Detection
text: Footprint filtering finds 258 photos whose coverage overlaps floodplain (vs just 40 centroid — see Figure @ref(fig:footprint-map)). priority selection algorithm picks 258 actually order: finest-scale photos first, backfilling remaining AOI gaps coarser scales coverage target met. default 95% coverage target, selection returns 148 photos: 1:12,000 photos priority — scale can identify cottonwood stands, wetland boundaries, side channel morphology, agricultural clearing patterns. 18 coarse-scale photos needed reach 97.7% AOI coverage. last percent coverage expensive. Pushing 95% 100% requires 101 additional coarse-scale photos — 1:31,680 — fill tiny gaps fine-scale footprints. 130 priority 1:12,000 photos every target: However, 95% target optimizes total area can leave entire stream reaches uncovered — Buck Creek’s floodplain segments small relative total AOI, algorithm skips . Enable Ensure AOI components covered guarantee least one photo every disconnected floodplain polygon optimizing area. adds ~25 photos (173 vs 148) plugs blind spots — far cheaper pushing 100% (249 photos). Figure @ref(fig:ensure-components) shows result. component coverage enabled: 173 photos 99.4% coverage. Blue footprints selected, grey unselected. Every floodplain polygon least one photo — blind spots Buck Creek isolated segments.

title: Selecting Historic Airphotos for Floodplain Change Detection
text: raw VCA produces hundreds polygon fragments, many tiny artifacts upper tributaries disconnected stream network entirely. Two flooded functions clean photo selection: fl_patch_conn(valleys, anchor_r) keeps floodplain patches touch rasterized stream cell. Isolated patches (VCA artifacts hillslopes, disconnected slivers) dropped regardless size. fl_patch_rm(valleys, min_area = 5000) removes remaining patches smaller 5,000 m². small meaningfully affect photo selection. Dual stream order anchor: VCA uses order 4+ streams input (clean output, avoids headwater noise), connectivity anchor uses order 2+ streams. matters large wetland complexes (e.g., Buck Creek confluence) connect main floodplain via small tributaries. Using order 4+ anchor drops ; order 2+ retains .
